name: Cerebras
tagline: Very fast AI inference for open models, served from Cerebras's own wafer-scale chips.
about: Cerebras runs open models at very high speed on its own hardware and offers them through an API.
pros: Among the fastest response speeds available for open models.
API follows the widely used OpenAI format.
cons: Smaller model selection than general-purpose clouds.
Rate limits apply on lower tiers.
